text:
It makes complete sense that you feel vulnerable when opening up about mental health. Sharing your journey requires a lot of trust and courage, especially when those topics are so personal.

You mentioned earlier that you've been through quite a lot, which often gives people a unique depth of understanding on these subjects. Even if your experiences aren't exactly the same as everyone else's, many people can relate to the feelings behind them—the fear, the hope, or the struggle to find balance. Your perspective might offer comfort or validation to someone who feels alone in their own story.

Would you like to brainstorm some ways to share your thoughts while still protecting your own boundaries? Or perhaps talk more about what specifically worries you about being open?
